template_notes: The parent must freeze the completed protocol and all source hashes after review.
FIXED and NEW_SOURCES are exported. Additional parent scoring/reference/review pins and source hashes are allowed.
The native_protocol pin must name the accepted CR20 protocol. All eight accepted references and previous frozen source sets are revalidated before model loading.
expected_sigmas and expected_smoke_sigmas must equal independent pinned-scheduler calculations for 28 and 4 steps respectively.
query_chunk_size is 65536. Baseline has one joint attention call per block; fixedmass adds old/new text calls; unnormalized adds new-text/image-only calls. No fallback is allowed.
execution_order: Validate submitted protocol hash, source/dependency pins, model revision and software.
Execute GPU kernel_smoke before loading any model weights; save kernel_smoke.json and require passed true.
Load one model. Run native1024 deployed, baseline, fixedmass and unnormalized for four steps each without VAE decode.

Save each actual initial packed input and final scheduler endpoint. Require shared input and initial conditioning bytes. Record deployed versus baseline relative L2/cosine; require relative L2 at most 1e-3. Require fixedmass and unnormalized native endpoints byte-identical to baseline.
Run baseline, fixedmass and unnormalized at4096 for28steps each. Save PNGs, sidecars, actual initial packed inputs, final scheduler endpoints and runtime gain/geometry/phase receipts.
Independently reopen all published tensors, sidecars and PNGs before writing completion.json. Parent scoring occurs after worker exit.
sidecar_hash_note: metadata and metadata_sha256 appear only in completion records. The PNG sidecar contains every other record field, avoiding recursive self hashing.
implementation_hash_note: The accepted runtime implementation_sha256 is retained. New worker/processor source hashes and the pilot protocol digest are separate config fields.
smoke_layout: OUT/smoke/ARM/IMAGE_STEM.json and tensor files; no PNG and no VAE decode
phase_validation: 57 expected block names each execute exactly steps times
full/old-text/new-text/image-only kernel counts equal the declared arm and native bypass
mass ranges are finite and within the pinned processor numerical policy, including its log-mass roundoff allowance
limits: Two existing satisfied development captions only, seed0, no fresh64 or seed search, no scorers inside this worker, no efficacy or novelty conclusion. Unnormalized control has substantial extra image-attention cost.
